blockers.title: No safe real entrypoint
blockers.observed_fact: 0 entrypoints were accepted for real observer; 8 were rejected and 2 remain replay-only.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: A real observer would need a proven read-only boundary that can feed the adapter without UI, DB, Supabase, runtime mutation or product wiring. That boundary is not present.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Produce a documented real entrypoint with tenant/session/activity, provenance/sourceTrace, idempotency/correlation, officialFlowRef and no DB/UI/Supabase/runtime mutation proof.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: replay fixtures, offline adapter, audits/preflight, documentary design, offline tests only
blockers.forbidden_action: real observer adapter, UI hook, WorkMap hook, Significado hook, runtime connector, DB observer, Supabase read, registry/export candidate real

blockers.title: Tenant/session/activity incomplete
blockers.observed_fact: Real signals do not prove complete tenantId, organizationId, sessionId and activityId context across the candidate set; fixture values remain synthetic.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: Without complete real context, observation cannot prove tenant isolation or bind replay results to the right activity/session.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Real signal evidence must include tenantId, organizationId, sessionId and activityId from a non-mutating read-only source.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: fixture replay using declared synthetic context
blockers.forbidden_action: using synthetic fixture tenant/session/activity as real observation evidence

blockers.title: Provenance/sourceTrace incomplete
blockers.observed_fact: Some real signal shapes show provenance, but complete provenance/sourceTrace suitable for real observation is not proven; sourceTrace is fixture/test-oriented for several categories.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: The observer must explain exactly where every observed signal came from, especially candidate generation inputs. Missing provenance/sourceTrace breaks auditability.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Provide real provenance and candidate sourceTrace evidence with source path, source id/line or equivalent stable origin, without touching WorkMap/Significado/UI/DB.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: offline replay fixtures with fixtureMetadata and source selection evidence
blockers.forbidden_action: treating fixture-only sourceTrace as real production trace

blockers.title: Idempotency/correlation incomplete
blockers.observed_fact: Real signals do not prove idempotencyKey/correlationId sufficient for non-mutating replay correlation.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: A real observer without idempotency/correlation cannot safely deduplicate, replay, or trace observed signals.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Produce real idempotencyKey and correlationId evidence, or a documented read-only derivation rule that does not write DB or touch runtime.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: fixture replay with synthetic idempotency/correlation explicitly declared
blockers.forbidden_action: creating correlation/idempotency values in production state for observation

blockers.title: officialFlowRef missing
blockers.observed_fact: No real signal proves a stable officialFlowRef comparator; it exists as fixture-only comparator data.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: Without a non-mutating reference to the official flow, shadow-vs-official comparison remains fixture-only and cannot be promoted to real observation.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Provide officialFlowRef evidence from a read-only source that does not activate or mutate the official flow.
blockers.forbidden_action: running official flow or generating export/registry output to manufacture officialFlowRef

blockers.title: UI/WorkMap/Significado touch risk
blockers.observed_fact: Candidate real entrypoints include or imply UI/admin, WorkMap or Significado touch risks.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: Gate 2 real observation must be non-binding; touching visible flows or product domains could change user-facing behavior or approved data paths.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Show proof of a passive observer seam outside UI/app/components/pages and outside WorkMap/Significado mutation paths.
blockers.forbidden_action: UI hook, WorkMap hook, Significado hook, app/API wiring, product observer wiring

blockers.title: Supabase/DB boundary not proven
blockers.observed_fact: No safe real observer boundary proves no Supabase requirement and no DB write/read risk. Any future DB read boundary would need separate RLS/auth/tenant proof.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: DB/Supabase access can cross tenant and authority boundaries; without proof, real observation is unsafe.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Document no-DB proof, or if a read boundary appears, prove controlled read-only access, RLS/auth/tenant isolation, and zero write paths.
blockers.forbidden_action: DB observer, Supabase read, SQL execution, migrations, RLS-affecting changes

blockers.title: Synthetic fixture fields cannot become real evidence
blockers.observed_fact: Replay fixtures declare synthetic fields explicitly and are valid only for offline replay.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: Synthetic fixture-only values do not prove real platform observation and cannot clear real signal gaps.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Replace each synthetic fixture-only value with real observed evidence, or keep the lane replay-only.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: fixture strengthening and offline adapter tests

blockers.title: Real observer design not allowed yet
blockers.observed_fact: The retry future allowlist permits blocker docs only, not real observer adapter/type/test files.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: Designing or implementing a real observer now would bypass unresolved critical/high blockers.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Clear ROB-001 through ROB-008 and rerun preflight before enabling a read-only observer design allowlist.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: blocker register, audit/preflight, documentary design outside product wiring
blockers.forbidden_action: src/types/eve-organism-real-observation.ts, real observation adapter, real observer tests until explicitly allowed by a future preflight

blockers.title: Replay-only lane remains the authorized Gate 2 path
blockers.observed_fact: Replay fixtures are strengthened and verified; real observation remains blocked.
blockers.why_it_blocks_real_observation: The only safe current Gate 2 path is offline replay and audit/preflight work.
blockers.required_evidence_to_clear: Keep continuation work inside replay-only lane until real evidence clears the blockers.
blockers.allowed_interim_path: replay fixtures, fixture strengthening, offline adapter, audits/preflight, offline tests without DB/Supabase/UI
blockers.forbidden_action: productive shadow activation, runtime connector, registry/export candidate real, diagnosis enablement
